title: Token burst–aware SLO decomposition and heatmap builder for multi-region failover
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Goal: Build a token-granular SLO decomposition and interactive heatmap that helps SRE and on-call teams understand per-region token-latency contributions, identify burst windows, and tune regional circuit breaker thresholds and admission policies.

Background: Current token-level SLI dashboards aggregate p95/p99 across routes and regions which obscures short-lived token bursts that trigger failovers. On-call frequently needs to know: was the p99 spike due to long tails in a single region, a burst of short requests with many tokens, or KV cache churn? This ticket scopes instrumentation, queries, panel designs, and a rollout plan that ties SLO alerts to tunable circuit parameters.

Success criteria (acceptance):
- New Grafana dashboard with an interactive heatmap: x-axis time, y-axis region-shard, color = normalized token-latency contribution (per 1k tokens). Heatmap supports zoom to 1-minute bins for last 6 hours and 5-minute bins for last 30d.
- Token-burst detector panel that flags windows where token-rate * median-token-latency exceeds baseline by > 3x for >= 30s.
- Decomposed SLO table that shows p50/p90/p95/p99 by: region, route, model-variant, and admission-path (served/evicted/late).
- Playbook mapping thresholds to circuit-breaker parameters (hysteresis, backoff, admit ratio) added to KB.
- Migration plan that ties alerts to a canary circuit profile and rollback mechanism.

Instrumentation plan:
- Add token_count and token_latency_ms as labels to existing request traces (lightweight counters, sampled at 1 in 10k for full spans, aggregated metrics at all data centers).
- Emit aggregated histograms per shard-region: histogram(token_latency_ms) with explicit buckets tuned for short tokens (1ms,5ms,10ms,25ms,50ms,100ms,250ms,1s).
- Add a derived metric token_latency_per_k = sum(token_latency_ms)/sum(token_count) over sliding windows (1m,5m,15m).

Queries (implementation notes):
- PromQL example for token_latency_per_k (1m):
  sum(rate(request_token_latency_ms_sum[1m])) by (region,shard) / sum(rate(request_token_count[1m])) by (region,shard) * 1000
- p99 by path: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, region, route, path))

Dashboard wireframe and panels:
- Top row: Global health sparkline (percent SLO met last 24h), current admit ratio, regional failover state badges.
- Heatmap: token-latency-per-k (core panel) with hover drilldown to last 5 traces.
- Burst detector timeline: stacked area chart of token-rate and median token-latency with threshold bands and automated annotations when detector fires.
- Decomposition table: sortable columns for routes with delta from baseline (7d average).
- Circuit tuning panel: shows current circuit parameters per region, historical events when circuit opened/closed, and a manual adjuster widget (link to console route settings).

Operational considerations and trade-offs:
- Sampling vs cardinality: attaching token counts to every request increases cardinality. Compromise: full counters emitted only at infra ingress, sampled traces for spans. Aggregation reduces cardinality but increases latency of detection.
- Cost vs fidelity: 1-minute bins provide fast detection at modest cost; 10s bins would be ideal but increases prometheus ingestion costs.
- False positives risk: short-lived developer experiments can spike token-rate; detector will require 30s sustained window and cross-region confirmation to alert.

Rollout plan:
1) Implement metrics in a canary region (us-west-2) behind feature flag (2d).
2) Deploy dashboard in read-only mode and validate with synthetic traffic harness (ENG-48888 + this ticket) (3d).
3) Open trial alerts to on-call with annotation-only for 72h, gather feedback (2d).
4) Enable auto-mitigation link to canary circuit profile; monitor for regressions; if benign after 7d, enable full alerting.

Testing and validation:
- Synthetic harness scenarios: sustained token bursts, KV cache churn, regional cold-starts, model-variant slowdowns. Use ENG-99876 harness for p95 KV-hit traces.
- Validation metrics: precision/recall of burst detector over labeled synthetic scenarios should be >= 90%/80%.
